correctness.rationale: The 11811 binary three-subspaces were exhaustively generated independently by 3-vector spans and unique binary RREF matrices and agreed identically; exactly 127 satisfied the degree-seven Welch zero sum. A seed scalar orbit exhausts these blocks. Its quotient connection set has 42 distinct elements, and exhaustive exact evaluation of all 126 nonidentity multipliers proves the seven codegree classes. A second direct adjacency implementation checks all 8001 unordered pairs. The irreducibility of t^7+t+1 and the field inverses are explicitly checked. Every relevant step is finite, exact, and reproducible from the embedded files; there are no unproved infinite limits.
